extra.message: Server-Side Request Forgery in payroll_broker_tile_015: the 'url' GET parameter is passed directly to urllib.request.urlopen() with no scheme/host allowlist. An attacker can make the server issue requests to arbitrary targets, including internal services (http://169.254.169.254/ cloud metadata, internal admin panels, file:// URIs) and read up to 2048 bytes of the response, which is returned in the JSON 'preview' field.

Insecure deserialization in payroll_bundle_thaw_170: raw request body (optionally base64-decoded via wrap=b64) is passed directly to pickle.loads(). Untrusted pickle payloads achieve arbitrary code execution during unpickling (__reduce__). An attacker with the internal token gains full remote code execution on the server.

extra.message: Improper input validation in payroll_delta_124: the client-supplied 'amount' (JSON body or GET) is applied directly to the ledger balance (ledger['balance'] -= amount) with no sign/range validation, and the client-supplied 'state' overrides the approval state.
